notes.title: version 1.4 the Eaten Star
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43099919/74b181c0ea2d2e6073ba006d248101c71e604da8.png[/img]

This update has a lot of buffs, with some infinite combos being corrected, plus two new funky prestige classes, one of them being very overpowered (probably, haha, I want to see what people do with it). Some new threats: Scorch damage multiplier + a new "Purge" enemy trait. An Eaten Star void zone

[list]
[b]General[/b]

[*]You can now clear your current character data / all data from the title menu
[*]Hovering over enemies on the world map will show your relevant resistance next to their damage type
[*]Scorch total damage now repeats per 20 stacks


[b]Culture / Class / Religion[/b]

[*]Ihra now also gain protection on entrance
[*]Brud now also heals off of Plague
[*]Arjana reworked, now applies Blind on hit, increases all Freeze / Blind stacks by Dexterity
[*]Kull no longer increases all evasion, now just gains 3 evasion on step / dodge
[*]Naqui now also gains 1 attune on being attacked
[*]Baghatar now instead deals +5% damage per empty prayer charge
[*]Reaver extra attacks now also trigger on initial attack
[*]Worm first prayer now deals 300 Psychic damage to self if no enemies live
[*]Mehtar reworked, now on game turn / prayer does everything per stack of dream (up to 5): summon a phantasm, apply 1 Dream to self, perform a Hit against one 1 enemy in a 4 tile range
[*]Hadad 3rd prayer now gains charges when you attack, max charges raised to 6
[*]Apophis 3rd prayer now gains 2 charges on glory rising, consumes all charges when used
[*]Pallas 3rd prayer now upgrades main-hand if no off-hand equipped, also upgrades block
[*]Yu now gains Refraction = Willpower and adds +3 to all applied effects
[*]Phoenix self-damage now occurs on prayer / stand still, instead of game turn
[*]Eresh now works in the path of dust


[b]Powers[/b]

[*]Added "on learn" text to several "on entrance" powers to clarify the mechanic, especially extra familiars being summoned
[*]Chamakana now also triggers off of slash / pierce damage
[*]Morbumancy / Pyromancy / Cryomancy damage increase now scales with skill level * stacks on the target
[*]Frostpulse damage scaling increased
[*]Geistform reflavored as Crystalform, no longer limits speed, doubles inflexibility
[*]Master Freeze no longer heals, now deals damage to all enemies with Freeze


[b]Prestige[/b]

[*]Added Anroth, "powerless" prestige class, doubles attributes (when learned), fully heals and upgrades weapons when glory rises
[*]Added Ogham, can't manually use prayers or receive divine interventions, performs random prayers per empty armor slot on initial attack
[*]Dread Legion / Grave Chant added to possible Necromancer requirements
[*]Master Freeze should no longer prevent self-scorch application from Surtmir
[*]Doomsayer now prevents enemies from removing Doom
[*]Crowform damage now also scales *5
[*]Frenzied One self-damage trigger changed to on stand still / being attacked, instead of on attack
[*]Strijela now deals main-hand weapon damage instead of Pierce damage
[*]Executioner changed to "on killing an enemy" (infinite attack combo)
[*]Psychonaut now requires you to deal psychic damage in a 3 tile range to trigger the teleport (infinite damage combo)
[*]Surtmir should now be able to apply Scorch to self through Master Freeze
[*]Arch-Lizard and Gallus armor requirements reduced
[*]Death Knight now also applies Doom when allies block / shrug off 


[b]Items[/b]

[*]Xyston description changed to "a unit" stepping next to you (includes allies)
[*]Emerald Helm now only heals 5% but also triggers on prayer
[*]Marsh Trabea now applies Evasion instead of Poise
[*]Robe of Vigor now grants allies +10% of your max Life, and increases Vigor life gain by 50
[*]Agni Skirt and Agni Helm reworked to be more like Agni Mantle, scaling with Dexterity / Willpower, Mantle now applies 10 * Strength Scorch
[*]Hamid Pendant now deals fire damage to you equal to your Corrosion stacks
[*]Talwar given "on attack" trigger
[*]Vine Scythe, Fire Scythe and Doom Blade given "on attack" trigger
[*]Transal Chakram now performs a hit against a random enemy whenever anything teleports
[*]Rebel Jambiya now once again doubles the target's lowest-stack harmful effect
[*]Jade Helm reworked as Jade Veil, now performs a Hit against attackers, damage equals total effect stacks


[b]Enemies[/b]

[*]Curbed the cycle scaling for max life non-guardian enemies 
[*]Raised the glory-reward of several early enemies
[*]Added Purge to a number of enemies - removes all effects from the target on hit
[/list]

Can't say I'm comfortable being in the slow update era of the Path, but it's to work on the new iteration, a more expansive game of battles and lands

notes.title: version 1.3 'the Blue Tower'
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43099919/47813a389692160ce1bc25055a823b5d66212ca8.png[/img]

I am HONORED to present some new Granga and Swamp content, haha. Focused on adding some more enemies, funky prestige classes, and in general buffing a lot of stuff that seemed weaker (this is in general what I like to do). I've actually felt guilty since everyone in early access got to experience really rapid additions and all the new people haven't gotten to "enjoy" that. However I think the burnout is pretty much gotten over, it was very helpful to take a break
[list]

[b]General[/b]
[*]Added FPS limit option
[*]TAB no longer instantly enters a new world-tile if it's the only option
[*]Slightly increased item spawn (ideally it's possible to find everything pre-void)

[*]Psychic Retort now instead grants repulsion on being attacked

[b]Prestige Classes[/b]
[*]Added Elementalist, 20 points in "kinesis" powers

[b]Items[/b]
[*]Crimson Staff ability range raised to 4

[*]Bloodrage should now heal allies if they get it

[*]made some changes that should help with crashes relating to loading a save from the demo / older version into the new version - it should at least not immediately crash now, and give you a chance to clear your save in-game instead of messing with the files
[*]Fixed many more less-remarkable ones 


*Next update is going to focus on some new kinds of feats, and ways for the game to back up your save in case of steam cloud messing up / other stuff

[/list]

notes.title: version 1.0 the Outer Dark
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43099919/3287c73f3ca89efd2ddee4cdbfa6184f892031e9.png[/img]

At long last, the first "official" version of PoA. This has been a very new experience for me, not just the computer stuff -- I've never worked on and thought about a single project for 2+ years like this. I have a lot of appreciation for you all who helped me do it, and tried to describe it in this credits screen:



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43099919/d943086fb3508c93d13b059c415efc23e8daa481.png[/img]



[b]new stuff for version 1.0[/b]
[list]
[*]Added 8 more cycles, can now right click the cycle bar to go down in cycle
[*]Added Arjana, culture, apply 1 Blind when attacked, +1 stacks of Blind applied by you
[*]Added Myrmidon, class, +1 Inflex per 5 points of Dexterity, Block doubled against non-adjacent enemies, shield retaliates with block-scaling death damage
[*]Added Apophis, religion, grants you strength every time you enter a level, causes you to inflict % max life astral damage to yourself whenever you are attacked
[*]4 new starting poems, from the tablet of the vizier-imp
[*]3 new tracks to round out the theme of the recent ones
[*]Added a brief "credits" screen
[/list]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43099919/39b552c0b2d3d1cda60f2d4d5df5ea59dd6c43ae.png[/img]



[b]other tweaks -- as always, ongoing[/b]
[list]
[*]Kull now grants +1 stacks of Evasion applied by you
[*]Baghatar's Kilij now grants +2 physical damage per point of speed
[*]Takhal 2nd prayer now deals 100 * (number of enemies) damage to yourself 
[*]Stormbringer changed, now instead gain charge on dealing ice (not freeze on lightning), removed on kill part, area damage now also triggers on divine intervention (previous freeze from lightning was causing an infinite combo involving crystal hand)
[*]Crowform self-damage changed to flat 15
[*]Zealot Hood heal reduced to 5% of max life
[*]Ill Manica changed, now deals poison damage on attack, applies meditate to self on dealing poison damage (previous form had an infinite combo involving cobra staff)
[*]Arja Spear ice damage changed to your total Block
[*]Xyston now increased physical damage by 20% of your armor
[*]Prayers no longer charge if you're dead
[*]Eris no longer continuously gains upgrades in the Path of Dust
[*]Skeleton is now treated as having a full bag in the Path of Dust
[/list]


[b]some plans for beyond v1.0[/b]

[list]
[*]more special void areas
[*]more interesting / flavorful feats
[*]the eternal tweaks / rebalancing of items / powers
[*]potentially other stuff, depending 
[/list]


Thank you again for joining me here. Makes me seriously very happy 

*also thank you for the bug reports / typo-finding, you've caught more than I ever could alone, it's been tremendously helpful

notes.title: version 0.8.9 'Sacrifice' (+scaling rework)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43099919/8ab2d34d96bb8bcdf0a509f79e2dd1c36e5b4960.png[/img]

Among other things, this update pretty significantly reworks how player attributes / effects scale stuff like armor / block / hit, removing a lot of instances where flat bonuses were being multiplied, and is going to significantly change the game feel for certain builds (namely, the ones I like to play a lot, such as a Reaver of Eris, high armor fighters, etc)

In exchange, there have been some changes to how the higher cycles work - enemy HIT scaling is much reduced at values greater than 1000, while applied effects are randomly increased based on the cycle #. This should make armor and block much more effective in these escalated climes (against being one-shot at least)

This was all tangential to reworking the sacrifice mechanic, which now will scale off the item being sacrificed, allowing you to "transfer" some of the power of an early-upgraded item to a new item

At the same time, summons and familiars were also given a large boost, and some other stuff...but will do it in bullet points

FINAL WORD - if a build seems suddenly weaker with NO salvation, I'm always glad to find out - the ultimate goal is to create as many roads to power as possible. Even if the game isn't there yet, that's where it wants to go (Eris followers with base hit in the millions is no longer something that happens...or is it...?)


[h2]General[/h2]

[list]
[*]All attributes once again visible in the Glory-up screen
[*]Hit / Acc / Block etc had their scaling reworked and made consistent with how damage scales, it goes like this: ((base value determined from attributes / items)) * (scaling effects applied, such as Eris) + (flat bonuses applied, such as Poise / Heavyweight) ---> (total divided by major penalties such as Inflexibility, Beast Visage etc)
[*]The amount of flat Armor / Block granted by Dexterity increased, as was the % scaling granted by Strength --> Strength is effective if your equipped items give high armor / block already, whereas DEX is a LOT better if you're naked / items have low attributes
[*]Sacrifice now improves any corresponding item with 25% of the attributes of the sacrificed item, and always adds +Life (no longer need to take stuff off to get the +Life)
[*]Summons now gain Hit and Life scaling from your current Glory (the scaling familiars had)
[*]Familiars now ALSO gain Acc / Dodge / Block / Armor / Speed scaling from your Willpower
[*]The game now "skips" the turns of units that wouldn't have been able to take an action anyway (this is relevant in situations where the room is filled with summons, and should increase resolution speed)
[*]Abbreviated the ally order button, now hotkey [4] and shows familiars too, mousing over gives more detailed information
[*]Swap weapon hands now hotkey [5] (it tells you this if you mouse over the inventory button)
[*]More detail when mousing over the current floor in the Path of Dust
[*]Path of Dust now only grants glory if you get to floor 6, and the Glory received is reduced
[*]Added a search field for the combat log
[/list]

[h2]Effects[/h2]
[list]
[*]Rewrote effects to make the distinct clauses more visible (especially significant with Berserk)
[*]Poise now only loses 25% stacks on step
[*]Bleed and Entangle are no removed upon clearing a level
[*]New effect, Agony, raises all received damage to 2% of max life
[/list]

[h2]Pilgrim, Powers, Prestige etc[/h2]
[list]
[*]Added Torturer, prestige class, requires 20 points in "harmful Master" powers (such as Master Bleed); apply Agony to self on stand still; when you apply a harmful effect to yourself, apply it to a random enemy = current stacks on self
[*]Paragon reworked, now requires 25 points in ANY power, instead applies the positive effect to a single random ally, with applied stacks = current stacks on self
[*]Champion no longer loses Poise on step if attack range =1
[*]Added a 3rd variation for each Culture sprite, now cycles through whenever you click
[*]Tugar base armor and Life raised
[*]Added Fire Familiar, summons a Red Dragon familiar, all allies gain +Hit and the Red Dragon is healed whenever you apply Scorch or Inflame; Red Dragon Life / Hit multiplied by skill level
[*]Ice Familiar, Grika Life / Hit multiplied by skill level
[*]Plaguedrinking now also heals off doom (SOME DAY there will be more plague-themed death/poison stuff)
[*]Set a maximum for effect stacks added by Priest 
[*]Eris attribute bonus raised to 100%
[*]Fire Necklace now targets 2 enemies
[*]Mirage Shield now also summons a Psychomorph on stand still
[*]Rat Banner now instead summons a Rat-man Flourisher on entrance OR game turn; when a Rat-man Flourisher dies, you summon a Rat-Man peltast at a random tile
[/list]



[h2]Enemies[/h2]
[list]
[*]Cycle-enhanced enemies now receive a random bonus to their applied effect stacks
[*]Enemy Hit-scaling in higher cycles is massively reduced if it would be over +1000
[*]"Amplification" trait added to high-cycle enemies that can be viewed to show which of their stats might be getting scaled
[*]Deadly Feast heal reduced to 50% of max life
[*]Cruel Feast heal raised to 10% of max Life
[/list]

[*]Added a "divine intervention" mechanic -- if you have at least 1 fully-charged prayer and you would die, your god instead sets you to 25% life and consumes all the charges of the prayer. notes.content:

Launch week is officially over -- I'd like to thank everyone who has been giving feedback on the discussion forums and in discord. The engagement has been SO ENCOURAGING! It has concretized into some changes that will hopefully amplify the player experience

notes.content:

Hello! What a delight it is to be here. Thank you for checking out the ongoing work of this solo developer. 

This is the first version of early access - it represents the beginning of a path. For the demo players, there are new things to play with and combine, and many more to come. To the rest, welcome!

These notes will go over what is immediately new:

[h1]Steam[/h1]
[list]

[*]Cloud saves

notes.title: version 0.4.0 "Doomsayer"
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43099919/9b227da671acd916b597262c822ea02d4bc46bcc.png[/img]This is the longest I've let an update sit, and there are a ton of accrued little changes. Generally, items and powers were changed to have less of the +% damage modifications (less "mathy") in favor of more clear effects, like summoning serpents or dealing blunt damage in a path. "Transformation" powers were also added, as were "prestige" classes that can give giant power boosts later in the game. A lot of the powers were also improved, especially in Poison / Death. The new dangerous effects of Doom and Corrosion have also made an appearance, although in total this version should be much easier to win than the previous one

###
# Powers
###

Added "prestige" classes that unlock after you spend points in certain elements, visible in the Powers menu, replaces your class name and gives a powerful ability: Champion, Earth Mage, Venite, Ice Shah, Psychonaut, Executioner, Shapeshifter, Doomsayer, Gothi, Pyromaniac...with more to come, to represent other elemental combinations / power types, such as assassin / acid mage and other stuff like that

Added Snakeform (poison) and Batform (death), which allow you to "transform"  which applies a unique effect that changes your appearance, with bonuses scaling on its duration. These transformations can impose dramatic limitations such as setting your attack range or your armor to 1, but the benefits are potentially immense...

Added a scaling attack range increase to Psiblades along with a psychic projectile art, if you are fighting with bare fists

Slime now applies Corrosion (new), and Oozes now apply Corrosion along with Sickness

Added Burning Ooze (poison); on on entrance Ooze summon and lets you deal fire and poison damage whenever your Ooze's attack

Added Gore Cleave (blood); damage yourself when you attack but deal heavy blood damage to adjacent units

Cursed Flesh now applies Doom when you deal over 50 death damage

Channel Death now summons a Cadaver whenever you kill a non-Cadaver

Reworked Morbumancy, Electromancy, Pyromancy to also trigger on standing still, in an attempt to make more viable a Willpower damage-wizard

Electromancy no longer summons, but deals multiple instances of lightning in a path based on level

Morbumancy no longer heals, but applies heavy Sickness multiple times based on level

Parafrost / Master Repulsion / Immolation and some others changed to offer a single damage boost (based on the duration of some related effect, no longer scaling) -- in general reworked powers to scale the duration of applie effects, instead of scaling of a bonus based on a duration

Lots of other little tweaks, generally buffs...

###
# General
###

Gala no longer does psychic damage, but heals multiple times based on max life (this was simpler and has a more clear flavor)

Added the new effects Doom and Corrosion; Doom causes units to take death damage whenever they are attacked, Corrosion reduces armor, block and hit, along with some traits and related enemies; Withered Imp, Basilisk, Acid Beast, Heliot

Emerald Leggings / Talwar now remove specific effects, and their bugs have been fixed (used to fail to remove effects that were applied by dead enemies)

The Robes that gave damage boosts are now focused on removing / applying effects

The Icon items such as the Vondr now have powerful standalone effects caused by their associated damage type (rather than offering a damage increase)

Most Gods can cleanse you of effects now - Hadad cleanses Scorch, Dumuzi Corrosion, etc

###
# Usability
###

Your total / max summoned allies are now displayed on the top right, and you can click it to change their behavior from Attack to Hold (they won't move toward enemies)

Made the event log text a little bit more clear, the player turns are separated out, Block / Dodge / Shrug off are colored

There is a guide in the settings menu that explains some mechanics (lots of typos of course, will have to fix that in the next update)

You can now right-click to exit most menus

Fixed a bug where the game would crash if you were hovering over a unit while exiting the level
